headline: Promoted Detective Joseph Venditto to Sergeant after interviewing three candidates in executive session.
summary: Three candidates for one Sergeant position were interviewed in executive session. The vote to promote Detective Joseph Venditto to Sergeant Officer was unanimous.
decisions: Approved promoting Detective Joseph Venditto to Sergeant Officer, unanimous vote.

decision_evidence.quote: At 6:24 PM, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to promote Detective Joseph Venditto to Sergeant Officer. Commissioner Zachery seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in favor.

decision_titles: Promotion of Detective Joseph Venditto to Sergeant
plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Police Commission Minutes         
         
Special Meeting 
 
5:30 PM, September 4, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Police 
Department 
Conference Room 
2900 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 Chairman Willis called the Police Commission special meeting to order at 5:30 PM 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 The Police Commission clerk, Nancy Forvil, took a roll call. Commissioner's present: Willis, 
Zachery, Hampton, White and Ladore.  
 
Chief Reynolds, Deputy Chief Sigmon and Attorney Sharkey were also present. 
3. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 There was no public comment. 
4. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 
 
  a. Enter into executive session to interview (3) three candidates for one Sergeant 
position. The candidates under consideration for this promotion are: 
 
1. Detective Joseph Venditto 
2. Officer Anthony Georgetti 
3. Officer Enrique Rivera-Rodriguez 
  
  At 5:38 PM, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to enter into executive 
session to interview (3) three candidates for one Sergeant position. 
Commissioner Hampton seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in 
favor. 
The candidates under consideration for this promotion are: 
1. Detective Joseph Venditto 
2. Officer Anthony Georgetti 
3. Officer Enrique Rivera-Rodriguez 
 
At 6:24 PM, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to come out of executive 
session to vote and promote one (1) Sergeant Officer. Commissioner Hampton 
seconded the motion. The vote was unanimous in favor.
At 6:24 PM, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to promote Detective Joseph 
Venditto to Sergeant Officer. Commissioner Zachery seconded the motion. The 
vote was unanimous in favor. 
5. OLD BUSINESS   
 There was no old business. 
6. NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
  a. Interview (3) three candidates for one Sergeant position. The candidates under 
consideration for this promotion are: 
 
1. Detective Joseph Venditto 
2. Officer Anthony Georgetti 
3. Officer Enrique Rivera-Rodriguez 
  
  
 
7. ADJOURNMENT   
 There being no further business to discuss, Commissioner Ladore made a motion to 
adjourn the Police Commission's special meeting. Commissioner Hampton seconded 
the motion. The vote was unanimous in favor. The meeting adjourned at 6:26 PM.
